description.value: Painted Turtle Guesthouse, also known as HI Nanaimo, is a Hostelling International hostel situated on Bastion Street in downtown Nanaimo on Vancouver Island. Its central location places touring cyclists within easy reach of the Nanaimo waterfront, ferry terminals, and the Trans Canada Trail network. As an HI-affiliated property, it is part of a global network of budget traveller hostels with a long tradition of welcoming bicycle tourists.
